title: Amazon API Gateway canary deployment
description: Create a serverless app using API Gateway and Lambda. Then create an API Gateway canary deployment

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern shows how to create an API Gateway canary deployment with a Lambda function behind an API Gateway REST API. Once the canary deployment is live, requests will be routed to the new and old version of the Lambda function at a rate of 50/50 using the Lambda alias from the APIGW stage variables to route traffic to the correct version.
